title: Home & Match History
caption: Landing screen: quick career snapshot, recent matches with result + a mini momentum sparkline, and one big New match button.

title: New Match Setup
caption: Minimal setup: names, surface, and the flexible format/scoring chips (best-of-3, pro set, match tiebreak, no-ad). The optional mood-marker toggle lives here.

title: Live Scouting — the fast screen
caption: The speed-critical screen. Every point is 3 taps: who won (big zones) → how it ended → shot type (now required). Ace/double-fault auto-fill the winner, and an "Other" shot option keeps entry quick when a shot doesn't fit a category.

title: Momentum & Stats
caption: The signature feature. The line rises on your runs, dips on the opponent's, with turning points marked and optional mood emojis on the same timeline. Key stats auto-calculated below.

title: Mental Reflection
caption: Quick post-match check-in: mostly 1–10 sliders and tap-faces, one multiple-choice, and one optional text box. Designed to take about two minutes.

title: AI Match Report
caption: The payoff. A scrollable report led by the standout Mind ↔ Match insight that connects mood to momentum — then match summary, mental/technical/tactical analysis, strengths, and areas to improve.

title: Welcome — Sign up & Log in
caption: New. The first screen in the real app. Create an account or log in with email + password and pick your role — Player or Parent/Scout. Accounts are secured in the cloud (Supabase), so you can log in from any device.

title: Profiles & Linking
caption: New. A player links the people who help them and shares an invite code so a parent/scout can connect and record matches from their own phone. Manage who can record vs view-only here.
